title: Data Enrichment Tools for HubSpot: Lusha, Apollo, Seamless.AI, Cognism, and ZoomInfo — Jon Martin
seoTitle: Data Enrichment Tools for HubSpot (Lusha, Apollo, Seamless)
description: Lusha, Apollo, Seamless.AI, Cognism, and ZoomInfo compared for HubSpot users, plus when HubSpot's own enrichment is enough. Prices checked Nov 23, 2026.
dek: These tools do not all do the same job. Some fill fields on records you already have. Others go find net-new people and direct dials.
Start with the records in HubSpot, then decide whether you need a specialist, and whether you need a price you can see before a sales call.

Best for.lusha: Self-serve emails and dials pushed into HubSpot, with a duplicate check.
Best for.apollo: Prospecting, enrichment, and outreach with a two-way HubSpot sync.
Best for.seamless-ai: Verified emails and phones imported into HubSpot, if you are fine buying through sales.
Best for.cognism: Sales-led data and CRM enrichment, including a two-way HubSpot sync.
Best for.zoominfo: Enterprise GTM data and a HubSpot connector, quote only.

sections.label: Start with what HubSpot already does

blocks.html: Before you buy a specialist, look at what {{link:hubspot}} already includes. Per HubSpot, {{fact:hubspot.enrich_included}}, and {{fact:hubspot.enrich_no_credits}}.
In practice, {{fact:hubspot.enrich_admin}}. By default, {{fact:hubspot.enrich_keep}}. One caution: {{fact:hubspot.smart_props_credits}}, so do not fold those into the free-enrichment story.

For firmographics and contact fields on records you already have, this often covers the job at no extra product cost. You buy a specialist when you need net-new people, direct dials, or a large third-party database feeding the CRM.
Pick by the job, not by who has a louder sales team.

items: Already have the records and just need fields filled: HubSpot's included enrichment.
Need self-serve emails and dials with a published price: Lusha.
Want prospecting plus a two-way CRM sync in one tool: Apollo.
Want a large monthly credit allowance and will take a quote: Seamless.AI.
Want sales-led, compliance-first data, pitched at teams selling into EMEA, or standalone CRM enrichment: Cognism.
Want enterprise GTM data with a HubSpot connector: ZoomInfo.

faq.q: Which enrichment tool should a small HubSpot team start with?
faq.a: Use HubSpot's included enrichment first for records you already have. If you need net-new emails and dials with a published price, look at Lusha or Apollo. Treat Seamless.AI, Cognism, and ZoomInfo as options you buy through sales.

closing: Fill the records you have before you pay to buy new ones.
